exact_prompt:
Edit this entire game diffuse UV canvas into a modest HD hand-painted texture. The attached full image is the native64x64 stored RGB reference enlarged exactly NEAREST8x to512x512. Keep the complete square canvas, every original field/black gap/contour/material/component at exactly the original normalized position and scale. No crop, padding, fitting, zoom, frame, recentering, arrangement changes or whitespace.

The upper grid has EXACTLY EIGHT columns and FOUR rows, thirty-two painted metal fields total. Preserve every field and original unequal soft tonal detail, without inventing or erasing any gridcell or changing its phase. Native source column edge-crest pairs are (4,7),(11,14),(18,21),(25,28),(32,35),(39,42),(46,49),(53,56), pitch7pixels. Four source row crests are y4,12,20,29, steps8,8,9. Do not impose a regular final row offset or enlarge the grid. These coordinates describe the full64x64 original reference, not the enlarged reference pixels. Keep source dim top/light edges and flat dark body of each field, subtle irregular painted metal, never shiny raised photographic blocks.

Preserve EXACTLY ONE existing lower-left ring opening and all the source lower gray/dark shapes and slender far-right curved field at their exact positions/scale. Those lower forms must not turn into new bolts, holes, engravings or extra components. Retain very dark charcoal slightly bluish-gray palette, each original weak localized painted highlight and original fuzzy black margins. Only gently resolve existing soft painted detail. No new cracks, scratches, grain, specks, bright white rims, hard bevels, specular glints, symbols, text, logos, rings or decorative curls. Keep relative intensity of dark cells and lower weak gray fragments, not uniform bright copies. Output opaque fullcanvas RGB; native source alpha is restored separately.

source_transform_recipe.operations: Native stored RGBA→opaqueRGB, wholecanvas NEAREST8x. No crop/padding/rotate/UV fitting/unpremultiply/art inserted. SourceA separately restored by root.
source_transform_recipe.inverse: ENTIRE raw LANCZOS to original4x; sourceA LANCZOS separately; scalar brightness and original native Type handling by root.

prompt_serialization: Exact actual built-in prompt UTF-8 argument including CRLF equals prompt file bytes; references portable identities resolved against current repo root.
